summary: First test iteration for Rekap Lembur app. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (auth httpOnly cookies, employee CRUD admin-only, overtime calc incl. midnight crossover, role-based PUT restrictions, filters, export CSV/XLSX, photo upload, stats). Frontend: admin login -> dashboard, employee sheet + add employee, add overtime with auto-calc total, edit overtime, export CSV & XLSX downloads succeeded, logout, employee login shows own-only records with NO admin controls (Tambah Lembur / Karyawan / Delete buttons hidden). All critical role-based access rules enforced on both UI and API.

ui_bugs.issue: Badge showing calculated total time lacks data-testid="badge-calculated-total-time" (mentioned in agent context but selector not attached; text 'Total Lembur:' is visible so functional works)
React a11y warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on multiple DialogContent components (radix)

issues: Uses browser default HTML <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component; guideline suggests using shadcn calendar for consistent UX in ID locale

action_items: (Optional) Attach data-testid="badge-calculated-total-time" to the total-lembur badge inside OvertimeAddModal & OvertimeEditModal for reliable automation
(Optional) Replace native <input type=date> with shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker for Indonesian locale UX
(Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside DialogContent components to silence radix a11y warnings
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth cookies use SameSite=None; Secure with allow_credentials=True and explicit FRONTEND_URL origin - correct for cross-site preview domain.
calc_total_minutes correctly handles midnight crossover; validated 17:00-21:30 = 270 min ('4 Jam 30 Menit') and 22:00-02:00 = 240 min ('4 Jam').
PUT /api/overtime enforces role: employees limited to start/end/location/note; date/employee_id ignored silently (works but could return 403 on attempt for stricter semantics).
seed_admin re-hashes password when it changes but does NOT bump token_version - old sessions remain valid after admin password change. Minor security consideration.
download_file (/api/files/{path}) requires auth cookie/token which prevents leaking storage paths - good.
